title: ALBentoItem (al-bento-item)
description:
Component: al-bento-item

A single tile inside `<al-bento-grid>`. Purely a grid-placement primitive —
it owns no visual surface (no border/background/padding) so any content
(a card, a stat, an image, a stack of copy) can be slotted in and supply
its own chrome. `colSpan`/`rowSpan` are reflected onto the host as CSS
custom properties, so they can also be overridden per breakpoint from
consumer CSS without touching the attribute.

slots.description: The tile's content (card, stat, image, or arbitrary markup).

cssProperties.description: Number of the 12 grid columns this tile spans. Defaults to 4.
cssProperties.name: --al-bento-item-col-span

cssProperties.description: Number of implicit grid rows this tile spans. Defaults to 1.
cssProperties.name: --al-bento-item-row-span

colSpan.description: Number of the grid's 12 columns this tile spans (1-12).

rowSpan.description: Number of implicit grid rows this tile spans.
